item.title: Parsa Venkateshwar Rao Jr | Budget 2026-27 Brings Back Old Populist Rhetoric, But It’s Still Muted
item.description: For quite some time now, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his Cabinet colleagues like commerce minister Piyush Goyal and railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw have avoided mentioning challenges and problems. Theirs was unqualified optimism that the Indian economy is doing well, and it can only do better

item.title: AA Edit | Budget Underwhelming, A Huge Missed Opportunity
item.description: Except for offering a tax holiday for data centres set up by foreign investors, the Budget had nothing worthwhile, either in terms of incentives or reforms. The finance minister could have undertaken various steps to improve the operational efficiency of companies without spending from the public exchequer
